name: Timers
summary: A little clock in the top bar. Click it to start a timer, run a countdown ("25m standup") or set an alarm ("7:30 standup"). Each one ticks beside the window chrome and survives a restart.

license.terms: Included under the ForkMesh repository licence.

permissions.label: Show a clock and your timers, countdowns and alarms in the window's top bar
Ping you when a countdown finishes or an alarm rings

screenshots.alt: The Timers clock in ForkMesh's top bar with four chips: a finished standup countdown, a review alarm, a running focus timer and a paused coffee countdown
